The concept

A full page, built around the favourites

This demo turns the items visitors name in public listings into a complete visit — menu, gallery, and directions in one place.

The menu above lists visitor-reported favourites, not a verified menu, and every photo on this page is illustrative stock — not photography of this business. What this concept adds is structure: the favourites up front, the visit details in one place, and a clear next step at the bottom.

Arts Bakery has been an Erie staple since 1950 — an open bakery, a full deli, and unique grocery items, now at two locations in Millcreek and Harborcreek. If anything here looks out of date, the fastest check is a phone call — holiday hours, pre-orders, and the day's specials are best confirmed directly.

Why this page works

Three things, done properly

No clutter, no invented claims — just the visit, made easy.

Visitor favourites first

The menu leads with the items visitors name in public listings, clearly labelled as visitor-reported — not a guessed menu.

Find it fast

Both Erie locations, phone numbers, and directions sit on one page, with a call button at the top and again at the bottom.

Confirm before you go

Holiday hours and pre-order cut-offs can change, so the page says so plainly and points visitors to a quick phone call to confirm.
